title: The Turtle Who Couldn't Stop Talking
author: Ellen C. Babbitt
summary: 乌龟答应闭口不言，随野鹅飞天，却忍不住开口，摔死了。
publicDomainBasis: Retold by Ellen C. Babbitt and published in 1912 by The Century Co. (pre-1923, public domain in the United States); Project Gutenberg releases it as public domain.

paragraphs.en: A turtle lived in a pond at the foot of a hill. Two young wild Geese, looking for food, saw the Turtle, and talked with him. The next day the Geese came again to visit the Turtle and they became very well acquainted. Soon they were great friends.
paragraphs.zh: 山脚下的一口池塘里住着一只乌龟。两只找食物的年轻野鹅看见了乌龟，跟他说起话来。第二天，野鹅又来拜访乌龟，彼此熟络起来。不久，他们就成了好朋友。

paragraphs.en: "Friend Turtle," the Geese said one day, "we have a beautiful home far away. We are going to fly back to it to-morrow. It will be a long but pleasant journey. Will you go with us?"
paragraphs.zh: 有一天，野鹅说：“乌龟朋友，我们有一个美丽的家，在很远的地方。我们明天就要飞回去。那是一段漫长但愉快的旅程。你愿意跟我们一起去吗？”

paragraphs.en: "How could I? I have no wings," said the Turtle.
paragraphs.zh: “我怎么能去？我没有翅膀。”乌龟说。

paragraphs.en: "Oh, we will take you, if only you can keep your mouth shut, and say not a word to anybody," they said.
paragraphs.zh: “哦，我们可以带你去，只要你能闭紧嘴巴，不跟任何人说一个字。”他们说。

paragraphs.en: "I can do that," said the Turtle. "Do take me with you. I will do exactly as you wish."
paragraphs.zh: “这我能做到，”乌龟说，“一定带我去。你们怎么说，我就怎么做。”

paragraphs.en: So the next day the Geese brought a stick and they held the ends of it. "Now take the middle of this in your mouth, and don't say a word until we reach home," they said.
paragraphs.zh: 于是第二天，野鹅拿来一根棍子，各衔住一头。“现在你咬住棍子中间，到家之前一个字也别说。”他们说。

paragraphs.en: The Geese then sprang into the air, with the Turtle between them, holding fast to the stick.
paragraphs.zh: 野鹅随后腾空而起，乌龟夹在他们中间，紧紧咬住棍子。

paragraphs.en: The village children saw the two Geese flying along with the Turtle and cried out: "Oh, see the Turtle up in the air! Look at the Geese carrying a Turtle by a stick! Did you ever see anything more ridiculous in your life!"
paragraphs.zh: 村里的孩子们看见两只野鹅带着乌龟飞过，喊道：“哦，看哪，乌龟飞到天上去了！看那两只野鹅用棍子抬着一只乌龟！你们见过比这更可笑的事吗！”

paragraphs.en: The Turtle looked down and began to say, "Well, and if my friends carry me, what business is that of yours?" when he let go, and fell dead at the feet of the children.
paragraphs.zh: 乌龟低头往下看，刚开口说：“哼，我的朋友抬着我，关你们什么事？”就松了口，摔死在孩子们脚下。

paragraphs.en: As the two Geese flew on, they heard the people say, when they came to see the poor Turtle, "That fellow could not keep his mouth shut. He had to talk, and so lost his life."
paragraphs.zh: 两只野鹅继续往前飞，听见人们来看可怜的乌龟时说：“那家伙就是闭不住嘴。他非要说话，结果丢了性命。”
